items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And my father’s name was William Henry Burrell.

ctx.x: [spells] D-A-Y, that was her maiden name, last name Burrell, of course. And my father’s name was William Henry Burrell. They were both from Virginia. My mother was from an area near Amsterdam called Roanoke. I’m not sure of the area that my father was from, but he was also from Virginia.
